hooks.text: Two days after staff measured a growing bend, the Quebec Bridge collapsed.
Why did the Quebec Bridge collapse after staff measured a growing bend?
The Quebec Bridge was doomed. Its workers' lives might have been spared.

title: Why Did the Quebec Bridge Collapse in 1907? ⚠️
description: The Quebec Bridge collapsed in 1907 after staff measured a growing bend. The Royal Commission did not believe the fall could have been prevented after August 27, but said better judgment might have prevented the loss of life.
